info.title: GovCon GSA MAS Schedule, SIN Mapper & PRC Compliance API
info.description: Transforms commercial labor rate cards, software/SaaS SKUs, commercial discounting practices, and past project histories into a GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Large Category F (IT) eOffer / eMod package: Special Item Number (SIN) Mapping Matrix (`54151S`, `54151HACS`, `518210C`, `511210`, `OLM`), GSA Price Proposal Template (PPT) Rate Card with 0.75% Industrial Funding Fee (`Net / 0.9925`) & 5-Year GSAR 552.238-118 Economic Price Adjustment (EPA) escalation, Most Favored Customer (MFC) & Price Reductions Clause (`GSAR 552.238-81`) guardrails, CSP-1 vs. Transactional Data Reporting (TDR) analysis, and a ready-to-submit `SCP-FSS-001` narrative.

post.summary: Generate GSA MAS Schedule SIN Mapping, 0.75% IFF Rate Card & PRC Compliance Package

commercial_catalog_and_lcat_rates.description: Commercial Price List (CPL), LCAT titles/rates, software/cloud SKUs, and standard commercial discounting practices.
commercial_catalog_and_lcat_rates.example: Commercial Price List (CPL) 2026: (1) Principal Zero-Trust Cloud Architect: $195.00/hr CPL (BS + 10 yrs, CISSP/AWS Pro); (2) Lead DevSecOps / Kubernetes Engineer: $172.00/hr CPL (BS + 7 yrs, CKA/Sec+); (3) Senior Cyber RMF / ISSO Analyst: $158.00/hr CPL (BS + 6 yrs, CAP/CISM). Commercial clients receive 4-6% volume discounts on orders > $250K; proposed GSA Net Discount is 8.0% off CPL before the 0.75% IFF.

corporate_experience_and_project_context.description: Past project experience (2+ years financial stability, SIN-specific projects), target GSA IT/Cyber SINs, and commercial customer classes.
corporate_experience_and_project_context.example: Target GSA MAS Large Category F SINs: 54151S (IT Professional Services), 54151HACS (Highly Adaptive Cybersecurity Services), 518210C (Cloud & Cloud-Related IT Professional Services), and OLM. Completed Projects: (A) DISA Zero-Trust ICAM & Kubernetes Cloud Migration ($2.4M, 2024-2026); (B) DHS CISA Continuous Diagnostics & Mitigation SOC Engineering ($1.85M, 2025-2026).

pricing_disclosure_pathway.description: GSA MAS pricing disclosure regime: 'CSP-1_Traditional_PRC', 'TDR_Transactional_Data_Reporting', or 'Auto_Recommend'.

submission_type.description: Whether preparing an initial GSA eOffer ('New_GSA_MAS_Offer') or a GSA eMod SIN addition / EPA modification ('Add_SIN_or_EPA_Price_Mod').
